images.qa: One upright gnomon casting three shadows in three different directions — the time sources disagree about where the light is. 16:9 approved first roll. The 4:5 took two re-rolls: the first came back with four shadows and two of them red, the second turned the shadows into double-headed arrows and read as a diagram. Fix was to restate the 16:9 wording verbatim at the new aspect and add 'absolutely no arrows, no arrowheads, no pointers, no diagram elements' — describing a direction invites the generator to draw an arrow.
